subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Avaliar e prever efeitos de intervenções nos ecossistemas, e seus impactos nos seres vivos e no corpo humano, com base nos mecanismos de manutenção da vida, nos ciclos da matéria e nas transformações e transferências de energia, utilizando representações e simulações sobre tais fatores, com ou sem o uso de dispositivos e aplicativos digitais (como softwares de simulação e de realidade virtual, entre outros).

components.description_pt: Identificar mecanismos de manutenção da vida, ciclos de matéria e transformações de energia em ecossistemas
components.description_en: Identify mechanisms of life maintenance, matter cycles, and energy transformations in ecosystems
components.cc_component_description: Apply conservation of matter and energy principles to each link in an ecosystem

components.description_pt: Prever efeitos de intervenções humanas em ecossistemas sobre organismos vivos e o corpo humano
components.description_en: Predict effects of human interventions in ecosystems on living organisms and the human body
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate both negative and positive consequences of human-driven environmental changes on biodiversity and ecosystems

components.description_pt: Avaliar impactos de intervenções em ecossistemas usando representações ou simulações
components.description_en: Evaluate impacts of ecosystem interventions using representations or simulations
components.cc_component_description: Interpret data from computer simulations to describe how Earth's systems respond to human-driven changes

components.description_pt: Usar ferramentas digitais para simular fatores de ecossistemas e avaliar seus impactos biológicos
components.description_en: Use digital tools to simulate ecosystem factors and assess their biological impacts
components.cc_component_description: Use digital simulations or calculations to compare the performance of competing design solutions

cc_matches.description: Human activities have significantly altered the biosphere, sometimes damaging or destroying natural habitats and causing the extinction of other species. But changes to Earth’s environments can have different impacts (negative and positive) for different living things.

Through computer simulations and other studies, important discoveries are still being made about how the ocean, the atmosphere, and the biosphere interact and are modified in response to human activities.
Use digital tools and/or mathematical concepts and arguments to test and compare proposed solutions to an engineering design problem.

Plants or algae form the lowest level of the food web. At each link upward in a food web, only a small fraction of the matter consumed at the lower level is transferred upward, to produce growth and release energy in cellular respiration at the higher level. Given this inefficiency, there are generally fewer organisms at higher levels of a food web. Some matter reacts to release energy for life functions, some matter is stored in newly made structures, and much is discarded. The chemical elements that make up the molecules of organisms pass through food webs and into and out of the atmosphere and soil, and they are combined and recombined in different ways. At each link in an ecosystem, matter and energy are conserved.
